title: Sensor unplugged -> I2C wait without timeout -> watchdog reset loop -> safe mode

trigger.how: Physically: pull the LIS3DH SDA wire (D4/A4) or its VIN. Or inject acc_gone (firmware talks to a wrong I2C address, as if the sensor were gone; persists across resets until 'scenario reset').
